sources.used_for: facility coordinates, joined on the TCEQ RN number

verdicts.MATCHED: time, direction and pollutant all agree with a filed report
verdicts.WEAK_MATCH: a report overlaps but the fit is partial or indirect
verdicts.UNEXPLAINED: no filed report matches this episode
verdicts.REGIONAL: other monitors were high at the same time, so the cause is not local

visibility_statuses.SEEN: the monitor recorded an episode matching this report
visibility_statuses.FAINT: a bump above background, below the episode threshold
visibility_statuses.UNSEEN_WIND_TOWARD: no bump, though the monitor was downwind for part of it
visibility_statuses.UNSEEN_WIND_AWAY: no bump, and the wind was not blowing toward the monitor
visibility_statuses.UNSEEN_UNKNOWN: no bump, and the facility has no reliable coordinates
visibility_statuses.NO_DATA: the monitor was not reporting for enough of the window

caveat: No matching report does not mean an illegal release. Releases below the reportable quantity, permitted emissions in poor dispersion, mobile sources and sources outside the searched counties all look the same here.
